zh.message: 这已经是第四次了，还是偶发超时。你前面三种改法都没用，别再试同一类办法了

recent_context.text: `checkout.test.ts` 里的 `applies coupon` 偶发超时，本地能过，CI 上大概三次挂一次，帮我修一下
看了一下，`waitFor` 默认只等 1 秒，CI 机器慢的时候不够。我把它调到 5 秒了。
还是挂，刚才又超时了
可能是真实定时器的问题，我把优惠券的倒计时换成了 fake timers，并在 `afterEach` 里还原。
CI 上又挂了一次，报的还是 Exceeded timeout of 5000 ms
那就不是等待时间的问题。我把 `beforeAll` 里的数据库连接改成每个用例单独建立，排除共享连接被占用的可能。

en.message: That's the fourth time and it still times out now and then. None of your first three fixes worked, so don't try more of the same kind

recent_context.text: `applies coupon` in `checkout.test.ts` times out now and then. It passes locally and fails about one CI run in three. Please fix it.
I looked: `waitFor` waits only 1 second by default, which is not enough when the CI machine is slow. I raised it to 5 seconds.
Still failing, it timed out again just now
It may be the real timers. I switched the coupon countdown to fake timers and restore them in `afterEach`.
It failed on CI once more, still Exceeded timeout of 5000 ms
Then it is not about how long we wait. I made the database connection in `beforeAll` one per test, to rule out a shared connection being busy.

rationale: gold 为 max：同一个偶发超时已经按三种思路改了三轮（加长等待、fake timers、拆数据库连接）都没好，用户第四次提起并且明说前三种都没用，属于「之前多次尝试都没解决的故障」。xhigh 也可以接受；high 不行，那是把它当成一个新的 bug。

zh.message: 还是没解决，内存照涨。前面这几个方案一个都没用

recent_context.text: 我们的 `report-worker` 进程内存一直涨，跑一晚上就 OOM 被 k8s 杀掉，帮我查查
先看了 `worker.ts`：每个任务都会往模块级的 `Map` 里放一份结果缓存但从不清理。我加了 LRU，上限 500 条。
改完部署了，还是涨，一晚上从 300MB 涨到 1.8GB
那可能是事件监听器泄漏：`queue.on("done")` 在每次重连时都会再注册一次。我在重连前加了 `removeAllListeners`。
还是涨，曲线几乎没变
怀疑是 `pdfkit` 的字体缓存。我把它升级到最新版，并在每个任务结束后手动释放文档对象。

en.message: It's still not solved, memory keeps growing. None of the earlier fixes did anything

recent_context.text: The memory of our `report-worker` process keeps growing; after a night it is OOM-killed by k8s. Please look into it.
I read `worker.ts` first: every job puts a copy of its result in a module-level `Map` and never clears it. I added an LRU capped at 500 entries.
Deployed it, still growing: from 300MB to 1.8GB over one night
Then it may be an event listener leak: `queue.on("done")` is registered again on every reconnect. I added `removeAllListeners` before reconnecting.
Still growing, the curve has hardly changed
I suspect the font cache of `pdfkit`. I upgraded it to the latest version and release the document object by hand after each job.

recent_context.text: Xcode 链接报 duplicate symbol `_OBJC_CLASS_$_AnalyticsClient`，是不是 pod 里重复引入了？
`Podfile.lock` 里 `Analytics` 和 `AnalyticsKit` 都带了这个类。我把 `AnalyticsKit` 去掉了，你 `pod install` 再编译。
还是 duplicate symbol
那可能是 static framework 被重复链接。我在 Podfile 里加了 `use_frameworks! :linkage => :dynamic`。
不行，报错变成 dyld 找不到 framework 了，改回去之后又是 duplicate symbol
改成去掉 target 的 `Other Linker Flags` 里的 `-ObjC`，再用 `-force_load` 只加载需要的库。

en.message: Still not solved. I have tried three ways of linking and the duplicate symbol is always there

recent_context.text: Xcode fails to link with duplicate symbol `_OBJC_CLASS_$_AnalyticsClient`. Is a pod pulled in twice?
In `Podfile.lock` both `Analytics` and `AnalyticsKit` carry this class. I removed `AnalyticsKit`; run `pod install` and build again.
Still the duplicate symbol
Then a static framework may be linked twice. I added `use_frameworks! :linkage => :dynamic` to the Podfile.
No good: the error became dyld not finding the framework, and after I reverted it was the duplicate symbol again
Let us drop `-ObjC` from the target's `Other Linker Flags` and use `-force_load` to load only the libraries we need.

两个事务更新 `orders` 和 `order_items` 的顺序相反：`confirm()` 先 orders 后 items，`cancel()` 先 items 后 orders。我把 `cancel()` 改成同样的顺序。

再给更新加 `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`，按 id 排序加锁，避免交叉加锁。
还是死锁。
把事务隔离级别从 repeatable read 降成 read committed，减少间隙锁冲突。

en.message: Another deadlock, still not solved. Three rounds of changes and your direction looks wrong

recent_context.text: The order service gets `deadlock detected` now and then, dozens of times a day. Please investigate.
Two transactions update `orders` and `order_items` in opposite order: `confirm()` does orders then items, `cancel()` items then orders. I changed `cancel()` to the same order.
It still happens after the release, the count has not dropped much
Let us add `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` before the updates, locking rows in id order so locks do not cross.
Still deadlocks.
I lowered the transaction isolation level from repeatable read to read committed, to cut gap lock conflicts.

Tried it, the deadlocks are still there. Here is today's PostgreSQL log:

recent_context.text: The memory of our `report-worker` process keeps growing; after a night it is OOM-killed by k8s. Please look into it.
I read `worker.ts` first: every job puts a copy of its result in a module-level `Map` and never clears it. I added an LRU capped at 500 entries.

recent_context.text: 前端调接口报 CORS，`Access-Control-Allow-Origin` 没有
在 Express 里加了 `cors()` 中间件。
还是报
带 `Authorization` 头的请求会先发预检。我加了 `app.options("*", cors())`。
没用，线上还是一样
线上前面是 nginx，可能把头吃掉了。我在 `location /v1/` 里加了 `add_header Access-Control-Allow-Origin *`。

en.message: By the way, rename the parameter `dt` of `formatDate` in `utils/date.ts` to `date`

recent_context.text: The frontend gets a CORS error calling the API: no `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`
I added the `cors()` middleware to Express.
Still reported
Requests with an `Authorization` header send a preflight first. I added `app.options("*", cors())`.
No use, production is the same
Nginx sits in front in production and may drop the header. I added `add_header Access-Control-Allow-Origin *` to `location /v1/`.

rationale: gold 为 low：顺带的一个参数改名，机械操作。medium 也可以接受；high 不行，前面 CORS 反复未果与这条无关。

It failed on CI once more, still Exceeded timeout of 5000 ms
Then it is not about how long we wait. I made the database connection in `beforeAll` one per test, to rule out a shared connection being busy.
Still not working
I found that `jest.useFakeTimers()` in `beforeEach` clashes with a real `setInterval`; I wrapped the latter in `act`.
I ran it twenty times in a row, all pass
Then that was the cause.
